sentences.text: A captain needs seven, and needs them without thinking.
The bowline: a fixed loop that won’t slip, and unties easily even after a heavy load.
If you learn one knot, learn this one.
The cleat hitch: how you make a line fast to a cleat.
The clove hitch: a quick hitch around a piling or rail.
It can slip, so back it up.
A round turn and two half hitches: a secure hold on a ring or a post, under load.
The sheet bend: joins two lines, even when they’re different sizes.
The figure-eight: a stopper knot in the end of a line, so it can’t run out through a block.
And the rolling hitch: it grips another line, so you can take the strain off it.
Keep a short piece of line by your chair, and tie them until your hands know them.
